rule.ruleText: Personal data may only be processed for a lawful purpose with consent (Section 6) or a legitimate use listed in Section 7.
rule.remediation: Verify there's a documented lawful basis for storing full names — either consent or a specific Section 7 legitimate use.

rule.citation: DPDP Act 2023, Section 9 (Processing of personal data of children); DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 10
rule.ruleText: Before processing a child's data, verifiable parental consent is required, including due diligence to confirm the parent is an identifiable adult (Rule 10).
rule.remediation: Check whether age-verification and parental-consent flows exist wherever this field feeds into onboarding.

rule.citation: DPDP Act 2023, Section 5 (Notice) read with Section 6 (Consent); DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 3
rule.ruleText: Every consent request must be preceded by notice describing what data is collected and why. Consent itself must be free, specific, informed, unconditional, and given through clear affirmative action.
rule.remediation: Confirm a notice is shown before consent is requested, and that consent capture meets the 'clear affirmative action' standard (no pre-ticked boxes, no bundled consent).

rule.citation: DPDP Act 2023, Section 5 (Notice) read with Section 6 (Consent); DPDP Rules 2025, Rule 3
rule.ruleText: Same notice-and-consent standard as email — applies to any directly identifying contact data.
rule.remediation: Confirm notice/consent covers phone number collection specifically, not bundled with unrelated purposes.
